title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain St. John's University-New York
description: Ten under-21-safe food stops on campus or along nearby Union Turnpike, selected for publicly listed evening availability.

cards.title: Montgoris Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: St. John's Queens campus
cards.notes: Check the University dining page before heading over, then use the dining hall for a campus-based meal when late-night service is in session.
cards.short_summary: The University identifies this all-you-care-to-eat dining hall as having late-night hours during classes.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John's describes Montgoris Dining Hall as open seven days a week with late-night hours when classes are in session.
cards.access_notes: Late-night hours are stated for periods when classes are in session; verify the daily schedule before visiting.

cards.title: Market Montgoris
cards.subtitle: Montgoris Dining Hall, St. John's Queens campus
cards.notes: Use the market’s stated meal-exchange window for a campus convenience option, and confirm availability through St. John's dining information.
cards.short_summary: A campus market with a published meal-exchange period through 10 PM every day.
cards.evidence_claim: St. John's lists Market Montgoris meal exchanges seven days a week from noon to 10 PM.
cards.access_notes: The University lists meal exchange from 12 PM to 10 PM daily; confirm current operations before going.

cards.title: Kin'd - Fresh Meadows
cards.subtitle: 192-03 Union Turnpike, Fresh Meadows
cards.notes: Place a pickup order or check the restaurant’s ordering page before leaving campus; Friday and Saturday have the latest listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: Thai pickup on Union Turnpike with 11 PM hours listed on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Kin'd's official Toast ordering page lists Friday and Saturday hours until 11 PM at 192-03 Union Turnpike.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are noon–10 PM Sunday–Thursday and noon–11 PM Friday–Saturday; recheck for holiday changes.

cards.title: POSH Pizza
cards.subtitle: 190-21 Union Turnpike, Fresh Meadows
cards.notes: Confirm the day’s service before traveling, especially on Saturday, when the restaurant lists a separate evening service window through 1 AM.
cards.short_summary: A Union Turnpike pizza and dairy-food destination with especially late Saturday service listed.
cards.evidence_claim: POSH Pizza lists Sunday–Thursday hours of 11 AM–11 PM and Saturday evening hours from 8:30 PM to 1 AM.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed late hours: until 11 PM Sunday–Thursday and until 1 AM during its Saturday evening service; verify before visiting.

cards.title: Benny's Kosher Pizza
cards.subtitle: 181-30 Union Turnpike, Fresh Meadows
cards.notes: Plan around the kosher schedule and call ahead if timing matters; the restaurant’s posted Saturday service begins after Shabbos and runs late.
cards.short_summary: A kosher pizza stop whose official site lists Saturday service through 12:30 AM.
cards.evidence_claim: Benny's Kosher Pizza lists Saturday hours from one hour after Shabbos until 12:30 AM.
cards.access_notes: The official schedule lists Saturday service until 12:30 AM; Friday and Saturday opening times follow Shabbos observance, so confirm that day’s timing.

cards.title: Sup Thai Kitchen
cards.subtitle: 178-19 Union Turnpike, Fresh Meadows
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s contact page to check the evening schedule, then arrange dinner or takeout before its later Friday and Saturday close.
cards.short_summary: Thai food near campus with official Friday and Saturday hours through 10:15 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Sup Thai Kitchen lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11:30 AM–10:15 PM at 178-19 Union Turnpike.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant lists 10:15 PM Friday–Saturday closing and 9:30 PM on other days; verify current hours before departure.

cards.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill
cards.subtitle: 176-61 Union Turnpike, Fresh Meadows
cards.notes: Check the location’s online ordering availability before walking over, and allow time for pickup before the posted 10:30 PM menu close.
cards.short_summary: A nearby fast-casual option with its online menu available until 10:30 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle's location ordering page for 176-61 Union Turnpike lists menu hours of 10:45 AM–10:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: The location’s online ordering page lists service through 10:30 PM; check live ordering availability before going.

cards.title: Empire Chinese Restaurants
cards.subtitle: 178-17 Union Turnpike, Fresh Meadows
cards.notes: For a late Friday or Saturday pickup plan, verify the restaurant’s live ordering status and place an order before the listed 11 PM close.
cards.short_summary: A Union Turnpike Chinese restaurant with 11 PM Friday and Saturday menu hours listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Empire Chinese Restaurants' ordering page lists Friday–Saturday hours of 11 AM–11 PM at 178-17 Union Turnpike.
cards.access_notes: Listed menu hours extend to 11 PM Friday–Saturday; the page also shows different hours on other days, so verify before travel.

cards.title: Union Food Mart and Pizzaria
cards.subtitle: 180-18 Union Turnpike, Fresh Meadows
cards.notes: Use its contact information or ordering page to confirm stock and service, then stop by before the consistently listed 10 PM closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Union Turnpike pizza and convenience-food stop listing 10 PM closing every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Union Food Mart and Pizzaria lists daily hours of 10 AM–10 PM at 180-18 Union Turnpike.
cards.access_notes: The business lists 10 PM closing daily; confirm same-day operations before visiting.

cards.title: Tandir Kebab House
cards.subtitle: 188-09 Union Turnpike, Fresh Meadows
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s own site before making the trip, and time pickup or dinner for before the posted 10 PM closing time.
cards.short_summary: A Turkish kebab restaurant farther along Union Turnpike with 10 PM hours listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Tandir Kebab House lists its address as 188-09 Union Turnpike and its hours as 11 AM–10 PM.
